intent.oneSentence: A moving luminous magic-source sheds short finite motes behind a dominant head, then all matter fades.
intent.firstRead: Directed luminous matter with compact detached pieces, not parallel noodles.
intent.mustNotReadAs: Long repeated strands, a dense particle cloud, unrelated orbiting magic, or fire.
intent.useContext: New plain arcane one-shot source studies at native scale on dark and light backgrounds.

readability.primaryShape: The unchanged changing head remains dominant; secondary matter occupies short unequal pieces.
readability.focalPoint: Existing luminous head, not new glints or an added glow mass.
readability.depthAndOverlap: Subordinate finite motes separated by open gaps.
readability.contrast: Original palette, source light and per-particle light retained.
readability.secondaryDetailBudget: Same 80 main particles, 100 sparks and 32 embers; no count increase.

mechanics.source: Existing moving luminous source and rear surface.
mechanics.driver: Existing inherited source velocity and analytic particle motion.
mechanics.direction: Unchanged directed source path and shed trajectories.
mechanics.weightAndMaterial: Stylized finite luminous matter using the existing energy-profile particle volume.
mechanics.causalChain: The source emits particles once at birth; each follows its old trajectory but paints finite local matter rather than its whole recent history.
mechanics.endingRule: Existing source fade, particle lifetimes and empty ending retained.
mechanics.exaggerationAndLimits: A generic energy-comet study, not arbitrary spell interpretation, physical particles, true depth or Niagara-quality certification.

phases.name: action
phases.action: Head moves and sheds short motes.
phases.cause: Unchanged source path and birth window.

references.source: src/core/particle-volume.ts and controlled original/short-history/volume native comparisons
references.observed: The volume candidate retains readable multi-pixel shed matter without the original long paired strips or the shortened control’s sparse specks.
references.application: Reuse unchanged energy-profile volume only in new plain arcane one-shots; preserve old modes and original head lighting.
references.limits: Three seeds and native/adjacent frames support a modest anti-ribbon gain. Short paired slivers and shard-like late fragments remain; full-speed playback is unreviewed.
